author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hunting for digital artists for custom Pokémon scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 Contact: Reply or DM on Threads.

author: Carolina
title: Looking for 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator

author: Creative Leads Community
title: Hiring 3D Character Artist & Animator for indie game
content: A small independent game development team is looking for a 👤 3D Character Artist & Animator (Remote - US Preferred/Applicants Worldwide Considered) A freelance contract for an artist to create 3D characters and creatures for a co-op game. Responsibilities include modeling, UV unwrapping, texturing, rigging and creating expressive gameplay animations in Blender. Requires proficiency in Blender and texturing, with organized source files and exports. Compensation is $15 USD/hour for up to 8 hours per week, starting with a 30-day paid contract. Contact: creativeleadscommunity.com - Join community to access this and 100+ similar opportunities Lead Id: 18211
